verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents automated workflows, such as board-consent workflows, the Gusto sync and automatic grants from offer-letter promises, so the question of managing those automations applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, change review, or rollback of automation or workflow definitions. Predefined vesting schedules and auto-collected data-room documents are adjacent features, not version control for automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
